# D9 all-even proof bundle — main summary

This bundle proves the D9 anchor theorem for every even modulus \(m\ge4\):

\[
  \mathrm{HED}(9,m).
\]

The proof is split into two ranges.

1. **High-even range \(m>9\).**  The symbolic D9 active anchor, affine splice
   placement, and terminal/reserve frame prove \(\mathrm{HED}(9,m)\).
2. **Finite low moduli \(m=4,6,8\).**  The same active anchor is used, but the
   affine basepoints are chosen separately modulo \(m\); the finite verifier
   enumerates the actual cosets and proves the required disjointness and
   transversality clauses.

Together with the corrected midpoint-collision paired growth, this closes the
odd branch \(d\ge9\) for every even modulus \(m\ge4\), without using the old
chained \(7\to9\) step.
